title: SVMap 1.2 ui/identity.json
description: What a map says about itself for the menus: name, dossier, authors, recommended players, tags, places and pictures. Client only; every field is optional. Rules a reader applies are in README.md.

name.description: The name menus show, mixed case, with the variant word when there is one (Enhanced Aquarius).

family.description: The name without the variant word (Aquarius); lists sort by it.

description.description: One or two plain sentences for map browsers and the content index.

dossier.description: When and where the map is set and one line about it; the source of SMapSettings.LegendMap.

authors.description: People or teams, in credit order.

version.description: The author's version of the map (SemVer recommended).

language.description: BCP 47 primary language tag of the map's texts (identity, mapinfo.json, localised actor properties); en when absent.

players.description: The lobby size the map plays best at. The range a map supports is gameplay and lives in sim/.

tags.description: Free lowercase facts. Known: 3v3, 1v1, competitive, casual, small, large.

places.description: The numbered areas of the briefing plan and the strategic map.

at.description: The label's anchor in UE space.

floor.description: Index in LevelInfo.MapFloors; absent: the floor of at's Z.

briefingProjection.description: snapshot: the briefing plan was drawn through LevelInfo.SnapshotCamera, so readers may mark places on it.

generated.description: Slots whose picture a tool drew rather than an artist (menu, briefing...).

picture.description: A path relative to ui/, inside ui/pictures/: PNG or JPEG, sRGB, at most 2048 pixels a side and 4 MiB, no text drawn in.
